China’s Huawei Convicted in U.S. Over Bank Fraud, Iran Ties

China’s biggest technology firm and the world’s largest telecommunications equipment maker has been convicted in the U.S. of stealing trade secrets and defrauding banks about its business in Iran. Huawei was found guilty on 10 of 12 counts by a jury in Brooklyn on Tuesday. The verdict all but brings to a close an almost eight-year-long criminal case against Huawei and three of its subsidiaries. The sprawling legal case spanned a 12-week trial, dozens of witnesses, …
